title: Nomad Sportfishing
specs: 52' Hatteras Sportfisher with eco engine and advanced sonar
Personalized sportfishing with just you and your crew, no large groups
Captain Mike Sorr with extensive experience and local knowledge
Bring California and Mexican fishing licenses valid for duration of charter
Bring driver's license or picture ID
Bring passport if fishing within 12 miles of Mexico; photo ID if no passport
Passengers must bring their own sleeping bag or sheets for overnight trips
Private charters for up to 6 guests
includes: Meals included depending on trip: breakfast, lunch, dinner for full days on water
Non-alcoholic beverages and snacks available on board
gap: Cancellation and refund policy not stated
blurb: Guests fish for species like Yellowtail, Dorado, Calico Bass, Yellowfin Tuna, and Bluefin Tuna on various trip lengths from hourly to multi-day. The boat accommodates up to 6 guests with private charters, offering meals and snacks included depending on trip length. Passengers bring their own sleeping bags for overnight trips and must have appropriate fishing licenses and ID.
extraNote: Alcoholic beverages not provided; guests may bring their own · Boat staff temperature checked; boat sanitized after every trip
